review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for competing concepts: `stepSet`, NFA/εNFA structures and inductive `Path` types. The only other `stepSet` and `evalFrom` machinery is in `Mathlib/Computability/EpsilonNFA.lean`. It handles ε-transitions, so it is a deliberate generalisation with its own closure-based API, and it relates to NFA through `toεNFA`. `NFA.Path` is a word-indexed inductive in `Type`. `Quiver.Path` has no word index and no labels, so it is not the same concept and would need conversions. I did not find a match worth consolidating for `Path.supp`, `reverse` or `toDFA`/`toNFA` either. `DFA.toNFA` and `NFA.toDFA` are the two directions of the DFA/NFA correspondence, not duplicates of each other. The weak candidates were the εNFA overlap and `Quiver.Path`. I abstain on both because the case for consolidation is unclear.
